title: feat(mcp): query_records expand and get_record related, every reached object judged by the read guard
body:
Fixes #35145 (PR 2 of 2: `expand` on `query_records` and `related` on `get_record`; PR 1, `latestPer`, landed as #35199)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 的 `query_records` 新增 `expand`（一次把商机的客户、负责人等查找字段展开成完整记录），`get_record` 新增 `related`（一次读出客户及其商机、活动等子记录列表）。
- 为什么改：问数场景里“这个客户和它的商机/活动”“每笔商机连同客户名”原本要 AI 连发多次调用再自己拼接；现在一次调用完成，且仍在调用者的权限、行级安全和字段屏蔽之下。
- 风险与回滚：不传新参数的调用完全不变；展开或关联到的每个对象都要过 MCP 读守卫，被守卫拒绝的对象让整次调用失败、不读任何数据；守卫放行但调用者无权读的展开目标不展开，字段保留原 id，调用照常返回。回滚即撤销本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-relation-reads.ts`（读守卫对目标对象的判定、关联字段校验、上限），`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 中 `get_record` 处理函数（先读父记录、再按父链接读子列表、截断标记），`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` 的 `stdioExpandMap`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-relation-reads.test.ts`，预期 28 条全绿（含系统对象目标整单拒绝、什么都没读）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`query_records` gains `expand`** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`): up to 3 (`QUERY_EXPAND_MAX_FIELDS`) of the queried object's lookup, master-detail, user or tree fields, one level deep (no dotted path). Each name is judged against the object as the caller is served it (`servedObjectDefinitionOf`), and the object it points at passes the MCP read guard, before any read. The names go to the bridge as `expand`; the HTTP bridge hands them to `findData` (which lowers and gates them as on REST: `assertExpandTargetsExist`, `servedExpand`), and the engine expands them through its one expansion path: one batched `id IN (...)` read per field via `engine.find`, under the target's permissions, row-level security and field masking. It combines with `latestPer` (the engine expands after the window read). Only the MCP read guard's refusal refuses the call: a target the guard admits but the engine does not expand for the caller (for example, no object permission on it) leaves the field holding its stored id, and the call is answered. The tool text says exactly that.
- **`get_record` gains `related`**: up to 3 (`GET_RECORD_MAX_RELATED_LISTS`) entries `{ object, field?, fields?, orderBy?, limit? }`, strict (no caller filter). Every child object passes the read guard first; then its link `field` must be a reference field of the child, as the caller is served it, that points at the parent (left out, the child's one such field is used; none or several is refused with the candidates named). The record is read first; each list is then one `query_records`-shaped bridge read of the child with `where` = the link to that record alone (`$contains` for a multi-value link), the child's own `fields` and `orderBy`, and `limit + 1`. Each list carries the same delegation-narrowing notice (`delegationNarrowed`, `warning`; ADR-0090 D10) that `query_records` adds when the agent ceiling narrowed that object. A list's rows are capped at 20 (`RELATED_LIST_MAX_ROWS`, never above `maxQueryLimit`) and served by the shared `servedQueryPage`, so a capped list carries `truncated: true`. The answer is `{ record, related: [{ object, field, records, total, hasMore, truncated? }] }`; without `related` it is the record alone, as before.
- **The rule** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-relation-reads.ts`): every object a new read shape reaches is judged by the MCP read guard exactly as the object the call names. A target the guard refuses refuses the whole call with `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 and nothing is read. Other refusals, all before any read: `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (unknown or non-relation `expand` name, a link field that does not point at the parent, ambiguous or missing link), `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` / 404 (a related object whose definition is not served to the caller), `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501 (a bridge that serves no object definitions). A related list's own read refusal is the whole call's, with its code.
- **`withheldFields`**: the record and each related list name the fields withheld from them, as plain reads do (#35179's helper, applied per row set).
- **HTTP bridge** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`): forwards `expand` into the `findData` query. One line.
- **stdio bridge** (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`): serves `expand` too, built as the data door builds it (`stdioExpandMap`): a non-reference name is `INVALID_FIELD`, a target whose declaration does not serve `get` is withheld (its field keeps the stored id, as `servedExpand` does).
- `McpDataBridge.query` gains an optional `expand?: string[]`. `@objectstack/spec` is unchanged. Docs: `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` gains an `expand` / `related` section. Changeset: `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `patch`.

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-relation-reads.test.ts` (28): the tool against a recording bridge. `expand`: the judged, de-duplicated names reach the one query; a guard-refused target (`sys_organization`) is `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no read; unknown, non-relation and dotted names are `INVALID_FIELD`; more than 3 is refused at the door; no definition member is `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`; a control without `expand`. `related`: the record is read before the lists, each list filtered by the link alone with `limit + 1`, the default cap 20, `truncated: true` from the probe row; a guard-refused child refuses the call with zero bridge calls; link inference, the several-links and no-link refusals, a field that points elsewhere, an unserved object; `$contains` for a multi-value link; an unreadable record reads no list; a list's own refusal is the call's; 4 lists, a limit above 20 and a caller `where` are refused at the door; each list's `withheldFields` equals a plain `query_records` of that object; a list the agent ceiling narrowed carries the delegation notice and the others do not; a diagnosis that throws never fails the list; a control without `related`. The stdio bridge: the expand map, a target that does not serve `get` withheld, a non-reference name refused before the engine.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/related-read-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (10, plus parity with plain reads on `withheldFields`): the CRM example over the live `/mcp` transport, real SecurityPlugin, SQL driver, `multiTenant: 'posture-only'` with two organizations. A member with read on accounts, deals and activities (not contacts), a row policy hiding closed-lost deals, `crm_opportunity.probability` and `crm_account.annual_revenue` withheld. Pins: deals expand `account` and `owner_id` into records with the account's withheld field still withheld; `expand` with `latestPer`; an account's related deals and activities, the RLS-hidden deal never in the list, withheld fields withheld on the rows; the tenant wall (organization B's deal pointing at A's account never appears in A's list; A's account is `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for B; B sees only its own deal); a 25-row list answers 20 rows with `truncated: true` and `total` 25, `limit: 5` with an order answers the first 5 and `truncated: true`; `expand: ['organization_id']` and a `related` `sys_organization` refuse the whole call with `PERMISSION_DENIED` and no record data; a related object the member may not read refuses with `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`; `expand` of `crm_activity.contact` onto `crm_contact`, which the guard admits but the member may not read, answers the call with the field holding its stored id and no contact data (the account on the same rows still expands); unknown and non-relation names are `INVALID_FIELD`; a control without either. Armed controls: the wall is real, the hidden deal and the cross-tenant deal exist at rest, the row policy binds, contacts are unreadable.
- Ablation of the read-guard check on targets (`judgeTarget`'s admit line mutated to admit every target, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; readings below).

## Acceptance notes

- **Push-down.** `expand`: one batched `id IN (...)` read per expanded field through `engine.find` (the engine's existing expansion path, no per-row loop). `related`: one list read per related list through `findData` / `engine.find` with the parent-id filter, plus the door's match count that serves `total` (the same count a plain `query_records` page runs). No in-app join.
- **A related object the caller lacks object permission on** answers `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` / 404, not `PERMISSION_DENIED`: its definition is not served to the caller, so the call is refused while the relation is judged, before any record read. The dispatch named "a target object the caller cannot read refuses the call"; it does, with that code.
- **An expanded target the engine does not expand for the caller** (for example, no object permission on it) keeps the stored id on the row and the call is answered (the engine's existing expansion behaviour, and `referenceNameVisible` where declared); only the MCP read guard's refusal refuses the whole call. Pinned in the dogfood run (`crm_activity.contact` onto `crm_contact`); the tool text, docs and changeset say exactly this.
- **Delegation notice on related lists.** Each list runs the same `diagnoseDelegation` check on its child object that `query_records` runs and carries `withDelegationNotice` when narrowed; a diagnosis that fails leaves the list as is.
- **Repo pin classification.** `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` classifies every non-test caller of `referenceTargetOf`; it now lists the two new callers (`stdioExpandMap` in `stdio-data-bridge.ts` as the decided `get` serving check, pinned by `mcp-relation-reads.test.ts`; `mcp-relation-reads.ts` as executing what the data door decides). This file is outside the claimed file surface: the classification is the pin's own requirement for any new caller. Its absence was the `Test Core (9/10)` failure on `3d6e7691fee` (this PR's, not main's); green on `0e7914f180e` and after.
- **`withheldFields`** (#35179) landed on `main` while this was built and is merged in: the record and each related list carry `withheldFields` exactly as a plain `get_record` / `query_records` of that object does (pinned in the unit suite with a visibility double, and in the dogfood run as parity with the plain reads). Rows nested under `expand` stay masked as a plain read of the target masks them; no per-target `withheldFields` is stated for them, because the note is per row set and an expanded record is nested in another object's rows.
- **A third-party bridge** that ignores the new `expand` member answers unexpanded ids. Both in-repo bridges serve it.
- **Overlap.** `overlap-check` at this head: `origin/main` merges cleanly; and the one open PR sharing files (#35193) merges cleanly too. (Earlier in the build #35179 and #35198 conflicted; #35179 has since landed and is merged in.)
- `#35145` closes on merge: PR 1 (#35199) carried `latestPer`; this PR carries the related-objects read. The ask-card kinds named in the card's "Done when" live on #35113.
